correctness.rationale: A generic coordinate ordering of each summand exposes (m-r)e_t+r e_s for a nonedge and (m-r)e_t+(r-1)e_s+e_u for an edge; every listed vector is exposed and no other vertex exists. Regularity forces exact distinct counts including r=2 coincidences. All outer squared centered norms equal r²(n²-5n+8)/4, with inner deficit 2(r-1); the outer barycenter equals c=r/2*1, proving unique minimal sphere. Since vectors are nonnegative, ||x-y||²<=2[(m-r)²+r²], equality precisely disjoint outer supports; matching count of q-regular complement proves existence/count and graph is independent-two-twin blow-up of its edge-disjointness graph. For G=C_n, complement edges are stable two-subsets, and Schrijver 1978 gives chromatic n-2. Independent enumeration of all n! coordinate orders and all diameter pairs on C5,C6,K3,3 matched formulas; the proof handles all admissible regular graphs.
